tasks.label: 清理 (Clean)
tasks.detail: 删除 build/ 目录（移动工程后使用）

tasks.label: 重新配置并编译 (Rebuild)
tasks.detail: 清理后重新 CMake 配置并全量编译
tasks.command: rm -rf build && cmake --preset Debug && cmake --build --preset Debug

tasks.label: 烧录 - DAPLink
tasks.detail: 仅烧录（不编译），使用 DAPLink
tasks.command: openocd -f interface/cmsis-dap.cfg -f target/stm32f1x.cfg -c "program build/Debug/firmware/firmware.elf verify reset exit"

tasks.label: 烧录 - ST-Link
tasks.detail: 仅烧录（不编译），使用 ST-Link
tasks.command: openocd -f interface/stlink.cfg -f target/stm32f1x.cfg -c "program build/Debug/firmware/firmware.elf verify reset exit"

tasks.label: 编译并烧录 - DAPLink
tasks.detail: 先编译，成功后自动烧录 (DAPLink)
tasks.command: openocd -f interface/cmsis-dap.cfg -f target/stm32f1x.cfg -c "program build/Debug/firmware/firmware.elf verify reset exit"

tasks.label: 编译并烧录 - ST-Link
tasks.detail: 先编译，成功后自动烧录 (ST-Link)
tasks.command: openocd -f interface/stlink.cfg -f target/stm32f1x.cfg -c "program build/Debug/firmware/firmware.elf verify reset exit"
